tos.intro: Please read these terms before placing a commission. Submitting a request means you agree to the guidelines below.

sections.title: General & Workflow
items: I reserve the right to decline any commission request that falls outside my comfort zone or schedule.
Progress follows the six stages on the Commission Board: Queue, Sketch, Lineart, Rendering, Review, and Completed.
Turnaround time varies depending on queue position, piece complexity, and revision feedback.

sections.title: Payment & Refunds
items: Work begins after payment is confirmed as agreed upon when your slot is accepted.
Full refunds are available only if work has not started yet in Queue.
Once sketching or later stages begin, refunds are no longer available except if I am unable to complete the commission.

sections.title: Revisions
items: Minor adjustments are included during the Sketch and Lineart stages.
Major changes requested after Rendering or completion may require an additional fee.
Please provide clear visual references upfront to keep revisions smooth.

sections.title: Usage & Rights
items: Finished commissions are for personal or channel/streaming use unless commercial rights are agreed upon beforehand.
Please credit febrianthomas when posting or displaying the commissioned work.
I retain copyright and may showcase finished pieces or WIPs in my portfolio unless you request a private commission in advance.
Commissioned artwork may not be used for AI training, datasets, or NFTs.
